programmes.d: Meglos plans to steal the ancient and powerful Dodecahedron from Tigella.
Posing as the Doctor, Meglos penetrates the underground city of Tigella.
Meglos escapes with the Dodecahedron and the Doctor is mistakenly held responsible.
The Doctor must prevent Meglos from using the dodecahedron to destroy Tigella.
What has become of Gallifrey? Who are the marauding Outlers? What lurks beneath the marsh?
What is the strange journey of the TARDIS? How do the Marshmen make short work of K9?
What is the secret of the Starliner. Why is chaos closing in on the Deciders?
What is the legacy of Dexter's research? How does the Doctor give evolution a small nudge?
The TARDIS lands on a world where the inhabitants live in fear of the Three Who Rule.
The Doctor and Romana are taken to the tower and meet the three mysterious rulers.
The Doctor discovers that he is facing an unstoppable foe from Time Lord history.
The Great Vampire begins to awaken from his long sleep...
(1/4) The TARDIS is drawn into an empty void, but they are not the only ones trapped there.
(2/4) When Rorvik learns that Romana is a time sensitive, he takes her prisoner.
(3/4) As the void shrinks, Rorvik plans to take desperate measures to escape via the mirror.
(4/4) Rorvik ignores the Doctor's warnings and takes a gamble which may have fatal consequences.
(1/4) The Keeper of Traken appears in the TARDIS seeking the Doctor's help.
(2/4) The Traken Consul holds Adric and the Doctor under sentence of death.
(3/4) Kassia, now the willing servant of the Melkur, is to become the new Keeper of Traken.
(4/4) Kassia completes the transition. The Melkur is only a shell, the real power lies within.
To repair the TARDIS's chameleon circuit, the Doctor goes to Earth for a real police box.
The Doctor travels to Logopolis where a series of fateful events are set in motion.
The Master is loose on Logopolis and is determined to learn the planet's secret.
With the fate of the universe at stake, the Doctor and the Master must collaborate.
(1/4) The arrival of the TARDIS is observed by three Urbankans.
(2/4) A Grecian philosopher reveals a bizarre secret about Monarch.
(3/4) Tegan accidentally pilots the TARDIS into space, while Lin Fitu betrays the Doctor.
(4/4) The Doctor undertakes a dangerous spacewalk to rescue Tegan.
(1/4) 17th century England is being stalked by a robotic death-like figure.
(2/4) The Terileptil leader is planning to wipe out mankind with plague rats.
(3/4) A mesmerized Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.
(4/4) Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding.
(1/4) On Deva Loka, Tegan falls asleep in the forest watched by the Kinda.
(2/4) When Hindle's breakdown begins, the Doctor and Todd are in danger.
(3/4) Panna shows the Doctor what the past, present and future holds for Deva Loka.
(4/4) The Mara finally breaks free of its dream dimension.
(1/4) The Doctor tries to recuperate within the Zero Room.
The Zero Room is gone, and the Doctor's regeneration is unstable.
(3/4) Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help.
A recursive occlusion threatens to destroy everything and everyone in Castrovalva.

As UNIT are transporting a nuclear warhead around Carbury, knights in armour arrive.
The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur's spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern.
Silent but deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.
With her crew slowly vanishing, Briggs assumes the Doctor to be the guilty party.
The Cybermen are released from their silos and on the march.
The Doctor realizes the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard....
The Master lures the Doctor.
Someone controls the Plasmatons.
A citadel contains Seraphim power.
The Doctor tries to outwit the Master.
During a clandestine meeting on Gallifrey, the Doctor is chosen to be a part of a terrible act; the Doctor and Nyssa trace something odd to Amsterdam.
Commander Maxil doesn't believe the Doctor is innocent; he thinks that the easiest way to stop the evil from being reborn on Gallifrey would be to kill him before the bonding can occur.
